Name: Ghilland farm with a cave onsen
Author: Ghilminion
Description:
A relatively large, flat farm with a plenty of space...and of course, a lot of waterfalls on it. If you are tired after the work, just jump in your private onsen in the cave and relax.

This map replaces the "Standard farm"

How to install:
1. Install the latest version of [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI
[/url]﻿2. Download and install [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4736]DaisyNiko´s Tilesheets[/url] and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10448]Lumisteria Tilesheets - Outdoor[/url] into your Stardew Valley/mods folder
3. Extract "Ghilland farm with a cave onsen" into your Stardew Valley/mods folder
4. Run the game with SMAPI
﻿5. Enjoy ;)
